sources.title: Evaluating Qwen 3.6 27B: A Complete Benchmarking Case Study
sources.snippet: This case study documents a complete evaluation of Qwen 3.6 27B across three quantization variants (BF16, Q8_0, Q4_K_M) using three standard benchmarks: HumanEval, HellaSwag, and BFCL.
